text:
sam: Quick thread on sidebar regrouping + breadcrumb behavior. I prototyped a compact model cluster that folds Models, Deployments and Pipelines under one parent. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder-compact-rail
ines: Pretty. Main question: how do we handle stable deep links? users rely on long permalinks from docs and alerts.
frank: proposal: keep canonical resource paths for essentials and use shallow paths for ephemeral UI state. Examples:
- canonical: /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId/deployments/:depId/runs/:runId
- ephemeral panel state: append ?panel=logs or use hash for open drawer (avoid breaking server routes)
tia: UX concern: the rail loses density if we nest too deep. Suggest adding a "jump" micro-nav at top of Models cluster: Recent / Favorites / All. keeps discoverability.
sam: +1 for Recent. Also thinking breadcrumbs should support a collapsed middle section when longer than 4 items, e.g. Org > ... > Model > Run. hover shows full path.
oliver: for permalinks, ops wants redirect rules. We'll add nginx redirects from legacy patterns to new canonical. How long to keep redirects? ops suggests 18 months.
nines: hmm 18 months might be heavy. Could start with 12 months and extend if telemetry shows sustained traffic.
a11y-bot: accessibility notes: collapsed crumbs must still be keyboard navigable and announce full path to SR. Also ensure focus lands on main content when navigating via deep link. Contrast check: small crumb link needs 4.5:1.
frank: implementation detail: prefer path tokens for canonical references, e.g. /metrics instead of ?tab=metrics. Querystrings are fine for transient UI toggles like panels/drawer state.
tia: copy note: "Deployments" vs "Runs" debate again. Users on self-serve often search "runs". Maybe label primary nav "Deployments" and surface "Runs" inside as a sublabel.
sam: good compromise. We'll add microcopy under the nav item: "(runs, jobs)" for clarity.
ops-bot: staging deploy queued for 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z. automated preview link will be posted.
oliver: add migration plan doc with mapping table: legacy -> new. Include test cases for external links and email notifications.
frank: e2e checklist item: open a direct URL to /orgs/x/projects/y/models/123/deployments/456 and assert the sidebar highlights Models cluster and expanded deployment entry. Also assert focus moved to main heading.
a11y-bot: add screenreader test that reads collapsed crumb as full path via aria-label; include keyboard-only navigation test to expand crumb menu.
sam: I'll update the Figma, draft the routing helpers (helpers should live in routing/paths.ts with a central map), and open an RFC PR.
nines: let's keep the URL contract strict: avoid ad-hoc query-based routing for important resources; prefer explicit, parseable paths.
tia: can we mock a starred quick-access bar at the top for power users? a tiny horizontal pill list.
sam: sounds good, we'll prototype. 15 min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT?
frank: +1.
nines: on calendar.
sam: cool, I'll attach the accessibility checklist and a migration telemetry dashboard in the PR. Thanks all. :tada:
